rows.method: Actual pocket boundary is separately certified outside the entire channel; outside winding excludes contained material. Every native moving fork triangle is covered by channel or rear halfspace. The channel opens through both bounded Z ends; blade tips may protrude into exterior air. Pure+Z insertion and reverse withdrawal retain the same X/Y cover; no adjacent-pair waiver.
